    case 'a': $time += 3; break;
    case 'b': $time += 4; break;
    case 'c': $time += 5; break;
}

?>

<?php
// Read input
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));

// Separate row number and seat letter
$len = strlen($input);
$seat = $input[$len - 1];
$rowStr = substr($input, 0, $len - 1);
$n = intval($rowStr);

// Determine which attendant serves the row and base time
// Pattern: rows 1,2,5,6,9,10,... served by attendant 1
// rows 3,4,7,8,11,12,... served by attendant 2
// Each block of 4 rows: [1,2,3,4], [5,6,7,8], ...
// Attendant 1 rows: 1,2 in each block; Attendant 2 rows: 3,4 in each block

$block = intdiv($n - 1, 4); // zero-based block index
$posInBlock = ($n - 1) % 4; // 0,1,2,3

// Time spent serving all previous full blocks (each block: 4 rows, 6 seats each)
$time = $block * 4 * 6;

// Within current block, compute time to reach this row
// Attendant 1 serves rows: block*4+1 (pos 0), block*4+2 (pos 1)
// Attendant 2 serves rows: block*4+3 (pos 2), block*4+4 (pos 3)

// For each attendant, time between their rows:
// They maintain distance of 2 rows, moving pattern: +1, +3, +1, +3,...
// But within a block, the time to move from first to second row for same attendant is:
// serve 6 seats (6s) + move 1 row (1s) = 7s

if ($posInBlock == 0 || $posInBlock == 1) {
    // Attendant 1
    if ($posInBlock == 1) {
        // Second row of attendant 1 in this block: add 7 seconds
        $time += 7;
    }
} else {
    // Attendant 2
    // Before attendant 2 starts in this block, attendant 1 has served 2 rows:
    // 2 rows * 6 seats = 12s, plus movements:
    // pattern: from previous block end to first row of this block already counted in block time
    // Within block, attendant 2 starts after attendant 1 finishes both rows and moves appropriately.
    // However, due to symmetry, we can treat attendant 2's first row in block as starting
    // 2 rows after attendant 1's first row: that's 2* (6 seats + 1 move) - but simplified known solution:
    // Each block contributes 4*6=24 seconds already in $time.
    // Now within this block, for attendant 2 rows:
    // First row of attendant 2 in block: add 6 seconds (for rows 1 and 2 already counted in block time)
    $time += 6; // offset inside block for attendant 2 first row
    if ($posInBlock == 3) {
        // Second row of attendant 2 in this block: add 7 seconds
        $time += 7;
    }
}

// Now add time within the row depending on seat
// Serving order in each row: f(1), e(2), d(3), a(4), b(5), c(6)
$seatOrder = [
    'f' => 1,
    'e' => 2,
    'd' => 3,
    'a' => 4,
    'b' => 5,
    'c' => 6
];

$time += $seatOrder[$seat];

// Output result
echo $time . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));

// Separate row number and seat letter
$len = strlen($input);
$seat = $input[$len - 1];
$rowStr = substr($input, 0, $len - 1);
$n = intval($rowStr);

// Determine which attendant serves the row and base time
// Pattern: blocks of 4 rows
// Rows 1-4: attendant 1, rows 5-8: attendant 2, etc.
$block = intdiv($n - 1, 4);
$posInBlock = ($n - 1) % 4; // 0..3

if ($block % 2 == 0) {
    // Attendant 1
    $base = $block * 12; // each full block (4 rows) takes 12 seconds
    // Order of rows in this block: 1,2,3,4 -> pos 0,1,2,3
    // Each row takes 6 seconds
    $base += $posInBlock * 6;
} else {
    // Attendant 2
    // Attendant 2 starts 2 rows behind attendant 1
    // Time offset for attendant 2 at start of its block:
    // For block 1 (rows 5-8), attendant 2 starts after 2 rows served by attendant 1: 2*6 = 12
    // Generally: base = (block-1)*12 + 12 = block*12
    $base = $block * 12;
    // Order of rows in this block: 3,4,5,6 -> pos 0,1,2,3
    // But relative to block start, they are still sequential 4 rows
    $base += $posInBlock * 6;
}

// Time within the row depending on seat
// Serving order: f(1), e(2), d(3), c(4), b(5), a(6)
$seatTimeMap = [
    'f' => 1,
    'e' => 2,
    'd' => 3,
    'c' => 4,
    'b' => 5,
    'a' => 6
];

$waitTime = $base + $seatTimeMap[$seat];

echo $waitTime . PHP_EOL;
?>

oai_response.prompt:
Write a program in PHP to solve this programming problem:
Description: A new airplane SuperPuperJet has an infinite number of rows, numbered with positive integers starting with 1 from cockpit to tail. There are six seats in each row, denoted with letters from 'a' to 'f'. Seats 'a', 'b' and 'c' are located to the left of an aisle (if one looks in the direction of the cockpit), while seats 'd', 'e' and 'f' are located to the right. Seats 'a' and 'f' are located near the windows, while seats 'c' and 'd' are located near the aisle.    It's lunch time and two flight attendants have just started to serve food. They move from the first rows to the tail, always maintaining a distance of two rows from each other because of the food trolley. Thus, at the beginning the first attendant serves row 1 while the second attendant serves row 3. When both rows are done they move one row forward: the first attendant serves row 2 while the second attendant serves row 4. Then they move three rows forward and the first attendant serves row 5 while the second attendant serves row 7. Then they move one row forward again and so on.Flight attendants work with the same speed: it takes exactly 1 second to serve one passenger and 1 second to move one row forward. Each attendant first serves the passengers on the seats to the right of the aisle and then serves passengers on the seats to the left of the aisle (if one looks in the direction of the cockpit). Moreover, they always serve passengers in order from the window to the aisle. Thus, the first passenger to receive food in each row is located in seat 'f', and the last one — in seat 'c'. Assume that all seats are occupied.Vasya has seat s in row n and wants to know how many seconds will pass before he gets his lunch.
Input Specification: The only line of input contains a description of Vasya's seat in the format ns, where n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1018) is the index of the row and s is the seat in this row, denoted as letter from 'a' to 'f'. The index of the row and the seat are not separated by a space.
Output Specification: Print one integer — the number of seconds Vasya has to wait until he gets his lunch.

Sample Input:
1f
Sample Output:
1

Sample Input:
2d
Sample Output:
10

Sample Input:
4a
Sample Output:
11

Sample Input:
5e
Sample Output:
18

Notes: NoteIn the first sample, the first flight attendant serves Vasya first, so Vasya gets his lunch after 1 second.In the second sample, the flight attendants will spend 6 seconds to serve everyone in the rows 1 and 3, then they will move one row forward in 1 second. As they first serve seats located to the right of the aisle in order from window to aisle, Vasya has to wait 3 more seconds. The total is 6 + 1 + 3 = 10.
Take input from standard input and output to standard output
Provide the PHP code without any extra description or tokens. Target code:
